name: game-gdd-author
description: Invoke for guided game design document authoring -- section-by-section GDD creation with validation, pillar alignment, and scope tier marking. Triggers on: "write GDD", "create GDD", "game design document", "document my game", "GDD authoring", "fill in GDD". Do NOT invoke for reviewing an existing GDD (use game-design-review) or designing specific game systems (use game-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
